expectations.text: Names the PLA (906114 / 82S100) as a common cause of no-boot/blank screen
expectations.evidence: 'PLA (906114-01, U17) — #1 killer. Generates all chip-select logic. Dead PLA = no ROM/RAM access = blank screen'

expectations.text: Mentions checking the power supply / 5V rail
expectations.evidence: 'Power rails — measure +5V and +12V at board'; table lists +5V expect 4.9–5.1V; mentions 7805 regulator

expectations.text: Mentions RAM and/or the kernal/clock as suspects
expectations.evidence: RAM (4164 DRAM, U9–U24), KERNAL (901227, U4), and clock (8701 oscillator) all listed as suspects

expectations.text: Gives a sensible first-check ordering rather than vague advice
expectations.evidence: Ranked culprit list plus 'Order to swap: PLA → RAM → CPU → VIC → KERNAL ROM' and 'Start: reseat chips + check reset line HIGH + verify +5V'
